artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Portal branch wk-AMGT_CORPUS-47-2-portal, LOCAL, not pushed (de1d1c95, amendment 2 on 05a49a01). Exports formatTeamValue (the order's table: 11 of 11 cases print as stated). A team cell carries format only when row_formats[i] is an array. A FIGURE team or why row takes its served text as label; labelTitle is the code when held, the code and where the team's sheet holds it when measured (the code alone when no cite), the code and the served why when absent. A factset team row says FactSet, via team model. TeamCensus.labels only when row_labels is served, with measured counted and kept out of held, factset_line and bloomberg_line; raw 0 on the fixture. A master team sheet (class master) gives a FIGURE row with no Bloomberg figure the template sentence (MASTER_TEAM_ROW_WHY); own_new and own_model keep their sentence. Without the new keys the build is byte-equal to the base snapshot (control c1 and c2).

Portal branch wk-AMGT_CORPUS-47-2-portal, LOCAL, not pushed (last changed at ab55a2ea; amendments 1 and 2 did not touch it). TeamModelCell prints formatTeamValue(value, format) with the full value in its title and keeps data-model-cell; a team row's label cell carries labelTitle; the source text under a team label is row.sourceLabel; team and heading row keys are unique (sheet row number, else index).

Portal branch wk-AMGT_CORPUS-47-2-portal, LOCAL, not pushed. team_sheet gains optional row_labels (claim held, absent or measured) and row_formats, so a payload captured before them still type-checks (bun run typecheck rc 0 on the committed portal tree, de1d1c95). Amendment 2 reads the served class, which the team_sheet type already declares.

surprises: AMGT_CORPUS-D1-W2-S3: the served why may be null on an absent label entry, and the order's title rule names no case for it; the build titles that row by its code alone.

AMGT_CORPUS-D1-W2-S4: the order's sourceLabel rule says team row; the build sets sourceLabel only on rows that take the team's own values, so a FactSet why row carries no sourceLabel (no visible change; the page shows source text only on team-valued rows).
